data.force_units_note: Force channels are stored as AMPLIFIER VOLTS (see /V in the .hea), with a different gain per finger. equipment_info.pdf gives the sensor range (+/-200 N) but the dataset ships no V->N constant, so absolute Newtons are NOT recoverable. This is why the Hyser literature reports %MVC. We do the same.

montage.note: Row 4 of 8 is a mid-row choice. Confirm array orientation in equipment_info.pdf.

signal.note: 'preprocess' records are already filtered by the Hyser authors. The bandpass/notch below is a light safety net, not the primary filter. Switch record_types to ['force','raw'] if you want to own the filtering.

target.note: Per subject, per session, per finger: reference = 95th percentile of |force| across that subject's MVC trials (flexion and extension). y = 100 * force / reference. Comparable to Jiang 2021 (~8.57 %MVC RMSE, within-day, random subset). NOT comparable in level to ForceBand's 0.85 N - only the SHAPE of the scaling curve transfers.
